candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false.
Delete the for loop that transfers to each address, so no transfers actually occur.
Replace the transfer amount `v` with 0 in the call, so each transfer moves zero tokens.
Replace `from` with `address(0)` in the call, so tokens are transferred from the zero address instead of the original sender.
Replace `from` with `msg.sender` in the call, changing the source address for the token transfer.
Replace `caddress.call(...)` with `caddress.delegatecall(...)`, so the call executes in the context of this contract rather than the token contract.
Insert `require(false)` before the for loop, causing the function to always revert.
Replace `_tos.length > 0` with `_tos.length > 1`, so transfers revert if there is exactly one recipient.
Replace `_tos.length > 0` with `false`, so the require always fails and the function never executes.
Replace `i=0` with `i=1` in the loop initializer, so the first recipient is skipped.
Replace `i++` with `i+=2` in the loop increment, so only every other recipient receives tokens.
Replace `return true` with `return false`, changing the final return value of the function.
Replace the entire `require(_tos.length > 0)` with `require(_tos.length == 1)`, restricting transfers to exactly one recipient.
Delete the `require(_tos.length > 0)` statement, allowing empty `_tos` arrays to be passed without revert.
Replace `v` with `v+1` in the call, so each recipient receives one more token than intended.
